name: hired-gun
description: Create, watch, instruct and stop temporary agents on a Mac, and read their structured results.

interface.shortDescription: Temporary agents, one task at a time
interface.longDescription: Launch a permitted task on a Mac with a one-time recipient command. Watch progress, send instructions, stop the job, and read its result. Account access requires owner approval.
defaultPrompt: Create a Hired Gun task for my Mac.
